recovery.source: Authoring code below plus node receipts; not a complete Figma backup

navigationAuthoringSource: const globalNav=async IDS=>{const mutated=[],rows=[];let checked=0,already=0;for(const id of IDS){const root=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(id),c=controls(root),primary=c.s.children.find(n=>n.name==='Primary navigation'),secondary=c.s.children.find(n=>n.name==='Secondary region')?.children[0],nodes=[...(primary?.children.find(n=>n.name==='Modules')?.children||[]),...(secondary?.children.find(n=>n.name==='Pages')?.children||[])];let links=0;for(const node of nodes){if(!('reactions'in node))continue;const old=cleanRx(node.reactions);if(!old.some(r=>r.actions.some(a=>a.type==='NODE'&&a.navigation==='NAVIGATE')))continue;const next=old.map(r=>{if(!r.actions.some(a=>a.type==='NODE'&&a.navigation==='NAVIGATE'))return r;return {...r,actions:[...(registry[r.actions.find(a=>a.type==='NODE'&&a.navigation==='NAVIGATE').destinationId]?init(registry[r.actions.find(a=>a.type==='NODE'&&a.navigation==='NAVIGATE').destinationId].stage,registry[r.actions.find(a=>a.type==='NODE'&&a.navigation==='NAVIGATE').destinationId].canonical):clear()),...r.actions.filter(a=>!hasOwnHistory(a))]};});links++;if(JSON.stringify(next)===JSON.stringify(old)){already++;continue;}await node.setReactionsAsync(next);mutated.push(node.id);}rows.push([id,links]);checked++;}return {mutatedNodeIds:mutated,rows,rootsChecked:checked,alreadyCorrect:already};};
